Public listing
“Headroom Mobile” 1.0
Jul 26. Two iPhone shots, one mostly empty iPad shot.

Today, side by side

  1. Weekly comes first. The demo seed is hand-ordered that way, and the phone shows rows in whatever order they arrive. The Mac always sorts 5-hour, then weekly, then model rows. P20
  2. “Resets in 2d 23h”. The Mac prints the bare countdown, “3d 23h”, and prints nothing when the reset is unknown. The phone says “Available” there. P15, G14
  3. Red numeral vs “Low” chip. When a limit is nearly gone (≤15% left) the Mac turns the number red. The phone adds a “Low” chip instead, which the Mac retired. Not visible in this capture. P19, G3
  4. System blue. The phone has no accent color, so every button, the demo banner and the waiting vessel are iOS blue. The Mac popover has no blue at all. G6
  5. Empty iPad. Two cards and a spend tile; about three quarters of the screen is empty, and that’s the shot on the public listing. G1, G18
The parity rule for this round: everything the Mac shows comes to the phone unless the phone can’t do it — and then we say why. The list of things that genuinely can’t come over is at the bottom: Not possible on the phone, and why.
